name: Jahaziel
title: Levite and warrior in David's army
summary: Jahaziel was a Levite from the descendants of Korah who served as a brave warrior during King David's time. He was among the skilled warriors who joined David in Ziklag. The name Jahaziel also appears in other contexts in the Bible, notably as a Levite who prophesied during King Jehoshaphat's reign.

keyEvents.title: Among David's warriors in Ziklag
keyEvents.description: Jahaziel was among the skilled warriors from the sons of Korah who joined David while he was in Ziklag, fleeing from King Saul.

keyEvents.title: Service as a Levite
keyEvents.description: As a Levite, Jahaziel had a role in the service at the sanctuary, highlighting the connection between the tribe of Levi and worship in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Prophecy under Jehoshaphat
keyEvents.description: A Jahaziel, son of Zechariah, a Levite from the descendants of Asaph, was filled with the Spirit of the Lord and prophesied encouragement to King Jehoshaphat and Judah as they faced a vast enemy army.

keyEvents.title: Jehoshaphat's victory after the prophecy
keyEvents.description: Following Jahaziel's prophetic word, Jehoshaphat and the people went out with praise, and the Lord gave them a miraculous victory without their having to fight.

keyEvents.title: Levitical Music Ministry
keyEvents.description: Jahaziel is also mentioned among the Levites appointed to serve with music in the house of the Lord during David's organization of worship.

keyEvents.title: Return from Exile
keyEvents.description: A man named Jahaziel is also listed among those who returned from Babylon with Ezra, showing the name's continued use in Levitical families.
